name: testsy
description: Check releases, investigate failed runs and save regression tests with Testsy.

interface.longDescription: Testsy runs QA tests written in plain English on websites and on iOS and Android apps, then shows the evidence for every check: a replay, video, the values seen, console and network. Use it from your coding agent to check a release before you ship, to find out why a run failed, and to turn a fixed bug into a saved regression test. It is for developers and teams who ship web or mobile apps and want proof that a change works. It needs a Testsy workspace (a free trial is included); runs use the workspace allowance, and a test performs real actions on the site or app it is pointed at, so use it on apps and accounts you are allowed to test.
defaultPrompt: Turn this bug into a Testsy regression test.
